## Source Messages

### 201 - 209

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="201">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />201 - Source analysis import (invalid analysis date format)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="201">

When a source analysis text file is imported that does not have a date, or the date provided is in an invalid format, this message will be generated. This message is specific to effective date and effective end date within the source analysis text file.

- Message Text: Source analysis import (invalid analysis date format)
- Data 1 Usage: File Name
- Data 2 Usage: Line Number
- Data 3 Usage: Value
- Message Class: Warning
- Message Priority: 12

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="202">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="202">

When a source analysis text file is imported that does not have a sample date, or the sample date provided is in an invalid format, this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Source analysis import (invalid sample date format)
- Data 1 Usage: File Name
- Data 2 Usage: Line Number
- Data 3 Usage: Value
- Message Class: Warning
- Message Priority: 12

</div>

#### 203 - Source analysis import (duplicate liquid quality example exists; record not imported) (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="204">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />204 - Source analysis import (liquid quality sample already exists; record not imported)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="204">

When a source analysis text file is imported that contains a sample (type A) that has a source analysis number and sample date that already exists within FLOWCAL and the Liquid Quality Source is configured to ignore duplicate sample dates, this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Source analysis import (liquid quality sample already exists; record not imported)
- Data 1 Usage: Source Number
- Data 2 Usage: Sample Date
- Message Class: Information
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="208">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />208 - Source analysis import (invalid analysis type (HC/NHC))</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="208">

When a source analysis text file is imported that contains a sample (type A) with the Analysis Type set to L or N (Hydrocarbon or Nonhydrocarbon) that does not match the Fluid Service already configured in the Liquid Quality Source Editor, this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Source analysis import (invalid analysis type (HC/NHC))
- Data 1 Usage: File Name
- Data 2 Usage: Line Number
- Data 3 Usage: Value
- Message Class: Warning
- Message Priority: 12

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="209">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />209 - Source analysis import (invalid product fluid service (HC/NHC))</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="209">

When a source analysis text file is imported that contains a sample (type A) with the Analysis Type set to L or N (Hydrocarbon or Nonhydrocarbon), and the Product defined in the import file has a fluid service that differs from what is configured in the Liquid Quality Source Editor, this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Source analysis import (invalid product fluid service (HC/NHC))
- Data 1 Usage: File Name
- Data 2 Usage: Line Number
- Data 3 Usage: Value
- Message Class: Warning
- Message Priority: 12

</div>
